issues.title: A no-op mutating command pushed no undo step; the next undo reverted the command before it (fixed: changed: false)
Undo of `material` restored only the colour (fixed)
Redo re-created rotated objects from an Euler snapshot: not bit-exact (fixed)
`display material` throws away colours set while solid
No command re-imports an exported file (Track 1 adding `import`)
`transform {verts: {from, to}}` rejected by the schema though the code supports it
No lossless mesh dump, topology measure or claimed/collateral diff in the API
`primitive` could not generate UVs (fixed: `uvs` option); default differs from Blender

data.summary: Round or chamfer edges, or a vertex corner.
data.description:
What stops a model reading as untouched primitives. One segment gives a flat chamfer; more give a rounded profile, and `profile: 0.5` puts those points on a circular arc.

`offsetType` decides what the number means, and the five give five different distances: `offset` is perpendicular from the edge, `width` is across the new face, `depth` is into the corner, `percent` is a fraction of the adjacent edge, `absolute` is along it.

`clampOverlap` stops a bevel wider than its geometry turning the solid inside out - it reduces the offset to the point where the faces would collapse, which means asking for far too much gives zero-area faces at exactly that limit rather than a mess.

Non-manifold and boundary edges are declined rather than corrupted.

edges.description: Edge indices to bevel. Default every edge.

verts.description: Vertex indices, for a corner bevel. Use instead of `edges`.

segments.description: Segments across the bevel. 1 is a flat chamfer. Default 1.

profile.description: Profile shape, 0 to 1. 0.5 is a circular arc; below it is concave.

clampOverlap.description: Reduce the offset rather than self-intersect. Default true.

loopSlide.description: Slide along an existing edge where one is available. Default true.

markSeam.description: Mark the new edges as UV seams.

miterOuter.description: How an outer corner is finished.

miterInner.description: How an inner corner is finished.

spread.description: Distance between the arms of an arc miter.

materialIndex.description: Material slot for the new faces. -1 keeps the neighbours'.
